assessments.reasoning: The rendered Scalar Functions opening describes elementwise extension as one of four extensions to arrays. The Appendix A terminal transcript multiplies the four-element vector by the scalar negative five, applying it to each element.

challenge.method: Compare the square-vector example with vector-scalar multiplication and separate the other three array-extension mechanisms named in Part 3.
challenge.results: The elementwise extension and example are supported. The evidence supplies no general array agreement, rank or later implementation rule.

limitations: The example concerns scalar multiplication with a vector. Agreement conditions for two arrays and later APL variants are separate questions.
